name: Hamed Niroomand
title: Frontend Team Lead / Senior TypeScript Engineer
tagline: I build and lead TypeScript frontends that ship.
summary: Frontend team lead and senior TypeScript engineer with seven years in production across the JavaScript ecosystem. I lead a team of five at Jack Westin, own the frontend architecture of a Vue 3 / Nuxt 4 product, and design the API contracts it depends on. On the side I build full-stack tools with Bun, NestJS and Hono, and maintain Cue, an open-source CLI that drives headless coding agents through a GitHub-issue pipeline.
